title: Celestial Chisel
body:
"A Chisel carved from the icy caverns by ancient golems from a distant past."

Description

The Celestial Chisel is a special Chisel found in the Ice Golem Shop for a price of $24,000.

Chisels are tools used to slice refined and forged ores into pieces and shave rocks to fit into processors. Do note, that shaving will reduce yield of the ore/rock, so it's advised to save them to be processed in a bigger machine later.

Appearance

A Chisel with the base of it being made out of Darkslate, the top being Refined Sapphire, and two ropes wrap around the base with a sapphire stone at the bottom of the base.
